practices.description: Source coverage and unresolved details.
practices.text: 11 source activities: two shortened mixed patterns; nine-target A/D/G cycle across the guitar range; two manual meditation continuations; ten naming variants per audience across two strictly separate diminished sets; two ten-sung-tone count variants per audience; two manual grounding activities. Singing counts participation, not a correct streak. Naming rounds inherit size 20 as an explicit app carry-forward, not a locally restated number. Source status: text_supported_audio_unverified. MIDI spelling uses pitch classes: h/B means B-natural (11), b/B-flat means 10; enharmonic names are not extra tones. Keyboard assessment, finite playback registers, ordering, assistance credit and sampling policies are explicit app adaptations; no physical-instrument or vocal-accuracy grading is claimed. Optional practice never gates class completion.
